user.title: Choose a valve
user.description: Select the Chandler valve to add.

token.title: API token for {name}
token.description: In the Chandler Legacy View app, open this valve's settings and enable the API. The app then shows an API token (a UUID). Enter it here. Disabling and re-enabling the API creates a new token.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token for {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The valve no longer accepts the saved token. Enter the current API token from the Legacy View app.

error.invalid_token: That is not a valid token. It should be a UUID such as 8dffdfbd-40cc-4b86-8df8-1d48463b20f1.
error.invalid_auth: The valve rejected this token. Check that the API is enabled and copy the current token.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the valve. Make sure it is in Bluetooth range and that no other app is connected to it.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.no_devices_found: No new Chandler valves were found nearby.
